description: AICTIONBOT™ offer scoring by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T11 (sourcing evaluation). Takes two or more offers with a price and scores (e.g. quality, delivery time, service, risk) and returns a weighted ranking out of 100, the gap between first and second, the tipping point (the smallest weight change that would put another offer first) and prices below 70 % of the median. Lowest price and shortest delivery time get full points, others proportionally; higher scores are better unless the criterion is price, cost, lead time, risk or defects. Without criteria the price gets 40 % and the other numeric columns share 60 %. Offers that fail must-have criteria (must_have: no) are left out. Pass the figures you read from the offers; to read offer documents use compare_offers. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

criteria.description: Optional criteria with weight (any scale, normalised to 100), better (higher or lower) and scale_max for scores on a fixed scale (e.g. 5 or 10). The name must match the key in the offers.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

offers.description: One object per offer: supplier, price, and further numeric criteria as keys or in a scores object; optional must_have (yes/no).

name: score_offers
title: Score offers with weighted criteria: ranking, gap to the runner-up, the weight change that would flip the winner, suspiciously low prices
